speaker: diane_sterling
headline: A BUDGET IS A FLOW, NOT A TROPHY.
deck: Allocation quality depends on where capital goes, how quickly it moves and whether the spending mix produces measurable public capacity.
quote: The question is not only how much was allocated, but what the allocation bought.
facts: Capital spending should create durable productive capacity.
Maintenance protects the value of existing assets.
Operating funds determine whether completed assets can function.
Leakage and delay reduce the real value of every nominal rand.
takeaway: Fiscal discipline is not underspending; it is directing money toward outputs that preserve and expand productive capacity.
